title: J65 - Sandstone Duck Detroit
text: Arguably the most coveted Detroit, these were produced in extremely limited quantities for just 4 months in 2001, January through April. They were made in only two colours, BLU "Blue", and BRK "Brick". J65 BRK has often been mistaken for the much more well known J97 CRI "Crimson", but is easily identifiable by the blanket lining.  These jackets are becoming increasingly sought after and hard to find in smaller sizes.
